new_g_rules.rule: In discharge instructions sections, common activities and self-care terms should be interpreted as patient education or functional activity education procedures rather than literal actions.
Slash-separated abbreviations should be expanded by interpreting each component individually, particularly common in physical examination documentation for negated findings.
Clinical status phrases describing patient function or condition should map to appropriate clinical findings that represent the overall state rather than individual components.

stage_1_span.label: Single_Letter_Clinical_Finding
stage_1_span.description: Single letters used as clinical abbreviations, particularly in physical exam sections, often representing clinical signs or findings

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Expand single-letter abbreviations to full clinical terms based on medical context and section. Common mappings: c→cyanosis, e→edema, d→drainage

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select clinical finding concepts that match the standard medical interpretation of the abbreviation in its context

stage_1_span.label: Compound_Abbreviation_Pattern
stage_1_span.description: Multiple abbreviations or clinical terms separated by slashes, representing a series of related findings or observations

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Expand each component of slash-separated abbreviations individually, then search for concepts representing each expanded term

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: For each component, select the appropriate clinical finding or observation concept

stage_1_span.label: Therapeutic_Rest_Restriction
stage_1_span.description: Terms indicating therapeutic rest, restriction, or reduced function of organs or body systems for healing purposes

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for therapeutic interventions or regimes involving rest or restriction of the specified organ/system

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select regime/therapy or procedure concepts representing therapeutic interventions over anatomical structure concepts

stage_1_span.label: Clinical_Status_Assessment
stage_1_span.description: Multi-word phrases describing overall patient status, stability, or functional state

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for clinical findings that represent the overall status or state described by the phrase

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Prefer finding concepts that capture the complete clinical state over partial matches

stage_1_span.label: Patient_Activity_Instruction
stage_1_span.description: Instructions for patient activities or self-care in discharge instructions sections

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for patient education or functional activity education procedures related to the instructed activity

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select education or training procedure concepts over literal activity findings

disambiguation_hints: Prefer examination procedures for section headers
